BiblicalUsage: Huppah is the head of the thirteenth course of priests in David's ordering of the temple service. His name appears once, in the list of the twenty-four courses. He is remembered because his course kept its turn, week after week, in the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Huppah matters because faithful service is often a turn kept, not a deed remembered.
